title: I built a living narrative world as a Claude artifact — and I spent 4 hours inside without noticing
author: Odranoel_Altrove
selftext:
Built entirely as a Claude artifact with persistent memory via the storage API.

A few weeks ago I asked myself a simple question: what does AI enable that was truly impossible before?

My answer wasn't a chatbot or a productivity tool. It was this: a narrative world that lives even when you're not there. Characters that remember everything. A story that no one else can ever replicate.

So I built Altrove.

You enter a place — a medieval village, an underwater station in 2187, a Renaissance court. You meet characters with their own secrets and desires. Your choices have real consequences. When you leave, the world continues. 

When you return, things have changed.

The first time I played, I spent 4 hours inside without noticing. I introduced my own mythology — ancient creatures called Leafant, a sacred wood, an elvish language. The world absorbed it all as if it had always been there. One character looked at me and said:

"You are different, traveler."

It wasn't a welcome. It was a recognition.

You can also create your own world from scratch — Every world you build becomes a living place with its own memory.

After seven hours inside, I came out with one conclusion: Every story is a journey in Altrove.

The question is : what you think about it? I would love to create a post where we can discuss in harmony thanks a lot.

comments.author: shadowlands-mage
comments.body: Nice pr. Can you share your work flow

replies.author: Odranoel_Altrove
replies.body: Yes i can. Altrove, runs as a Claude artifact in React. Persistent memory via Claude's artifact storage API — each world saves characters, relationships, events, lore and narrative threads across sessions. The AI narrator gets the full world state as context on every call. No external database, no backend. Just Claude and the storage API. Happy to go deeper if you're interested.

comments.author: RatbyteGames
comments.body:
I've been thinking we are not far from a future where people will ask AI to "make" them a movie, book, podcast, story etc.

So instead of scrolling netflix for a good movie, you will ask AIFlix to create a action thriller with a twist at the end and have dolphins and set in Hawaii. It will create it on the fly.

Likewise you could ask for a podcast on migratory swallows for the commute into a job that doesn't exist because Ai is doing it now and you got fired.

comments.author: Odranoel_Altrove
comments.body:
Update — June 8:
Narrative tone improved: deeper second-person immersion, sensory details first, mystery shown not explained( important difference, explained on the new feature part)
New feature: you can now suggest a narrative direction before each message — a subtle field that lets you steer the story without breaking the flow( this is a strange feeling, the versione of Altrove was more feeling like a storyteller about your presence inside Altrove, now instead,it's more likely you are truly living in it).
English version fully ready( because i'm italian, the word Altrove comes from italian vocabulary and translated in english for those who are curious, it means, Elsewhere).
